tallyr

tallyr is an R interface to the Tally form builder API. Authenticate with an API key, list your forms, and import form submissions as tidy tibbles.

Installation

You can install the development version of tallyr from GitHub with:

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("EllaKaye/tallyr")

Authentication

Tally uses personal API keys. Create one at Tally Settings > API keys, then store it in the TALLY_API_KEY environment variable in your .Renviron (e.g. via usethis::edit_r_environ()):

TALLY_API_KEY=tly-xxxx

To check your setup, run:

library(tallyr)
tally_sitrep()

or, for a quick check that you’re authenticated:

tally_whoami()
#> ✔ Authenticated with Tally as Ella Kaye (hello@ellakaye.co.uk)

Multiple accounts

If you work with several Tally accounts, store each account’s key in its own TALLY_API_KEY_<NAME> environment variable:

TALLY_API_KEY=tly-xxxx
TALLY_API_KEY_WORK=tly-yyyy
TALLY_API_KEY_RLADIES=tly-zzzz

tally_accounts() lists the accounts with a key available, and tally_use_account() switches between them for the rest of the session:

tally_accounts()
#> [1] "default" "rladies" "work"

tally_use_account("work")
#> ✔ Using Tally account "work"
tally_forms() # uses the "work" account

Every API function also takes an account argument for one-off calls without switching:

tally_forms(account = "rladies")

Importing form data

List your forms to find the ID of the one you want:

tally_forms()
#> # A tibble: 2 × 8
#>   id     name                status    number_of_submissions is_closed …
#> 1 3xLJ5V Conference feedback PUBLISHED                    42 FALSE
#> 2 7bQm2W Workshop signup     DRAFT                         0 FALSE

Then import its submissions as a wide tibble, with one row per submission and one column per question:

tally_submissions("3xLJ5V")
#> # A tibble: 42 × 5
#>   submission_id submitted_at        is_completed `What's your name?` …
#> 1 nWxyzA        2026-06-01 10:00:00 TRUE         Ada
#> 2 nWxyzB        2026-06-02 11:30:00 TRUE         Grace
#> # …

Submissions can be filtered by completion status and date:

tally_submissions(
  "3xLJ5V",
  filter = "completed",
  start_date = "2026-01-01"
)

All functions handle pagination automatically and respect Tally’s rate limit of 100 requests per minute.
